parameters.name: Cluster

parameters.description: The URL for retrieving the address of the underlying OceanBase server.

parameters.description: The description of the data source.

parameters.name: DrcUserName

parameters.description: The Base64-encoded password for the \_\_oceanbase\_inner\_drc\_user account.

parameters.name: Ip

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the data source.

parameters.name: Password

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: The port number of the database host.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The type of the data source.
